mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM send_command_context WHERE conversation_id=#{conversation} AND state IN ('approved','sending') AND product_cards<>'[]' AND final_content=#{content}
SELECT * FROM shops WHERE id=#{shopId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM messages WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND (event_id=#{eventId} OR platform_message_id=#{platformMessageId})
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND buyer_ref=#{buyerRef} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE drafts SET state='outdated' WHERE message_id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId}) AND state='waiting_human'
UPDATE messages SET state='waiting_human' WHERE id=#{messageId}
UPDATE messages SET state='sent' WHERE id=#{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id FROM messages m JOIN reply_questions q ON q.message_id=m.id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND m.platform_message_id=#{platformId} AND q.answered_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reply_run_messages rm JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id=rm.run_id WHERE rm.message_id=m.id AND r.state IN ('running','completed')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reply_command_messages cm WHERE cm.message_id=m.id)

SELECT m.id,q.answered_at,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reply_command_messages cm WHERE cm.message_id=m.id) THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS can_generate FROM messages m JOIN reply_questions q ON q.message_id=m.id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND m.platform_message_id=#{platformId} AND m.direction='inbound' AND m.message_type IN ('text','emotion')
